europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Hit Kyiv During German Chancellor Visit
europe_now.summary: New Russian drone strikes hit infrastructure in Kyiv while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited the Ukrainian capital to pledge support. The attacks coincide with heightened concerns over security as officials anticipate a severe winter.

europe_now.title: Latvian Parliamentary Election Results
europe_now.summary: Partial election results in Latvia indicate that Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs's pro-Ukraine party is leading the parliamentary vote. The outcome strengthens prospects for forming another pro-Ukraine coalition government.

top_stories.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina General Election
top_stories.summary: Citizens in Bosnia and Herzegovina cast ballots in a general election defined by enduring wartime divisions and ethnic tensions. The electoral contest takes place amid divisive campaigns and ongoing debates concerning the nation's European Union integration path.
